description: Artifact Registry cleanup policy for the amjis repository. Wave 4 4.edge_and_infra_hygiene.

rules.description: Keep the 10 most-recent tagged revisions per service image.
Delete untagged images older than 7 days.
Delete sha-/pr- tagged images older than 90 days.

notes: Apply with: gcloud artifacts repositories set-cleanup-policies amjis --location=asia-south1 --policy=cleanup_policy.json --no-dry-run

Migration off legacy gcr.io: image refs in .github/workflows/deploy.yml + platform-mcp/cloudbuild.yaml all point at asia-south1-docker.pkg.dev/madhav-astrology/amjis/* (verified by edge_security_smoke.sh).
